Review each20-trade block; interrogate DOM/reversal vs continuation/session/regime; product prop barrier. Layer1 DAILY news calendar→daily chart reference points→30-min TPO thesis, auction location, expected controller, logical target. Layer2 per-trade thesis filter before feature/regime naming. Any NO→No trade.Wait. Example short at lower curve boundary should be skipped because buyers expected. These are sequential AND gates; cannot replace by OR of unrelated detections.

Part2 layer2 continuation: dynamic size to survive2-3 unnoticed losses→DOM confirms LOCATION→PACING→DIGITS, NO means no entry. YES→logical target POC/value/VAH/poor high-low (60-80% quoted expectation, not fixed target criterion). Layer3 journal pre-entry viewpoint from recording then result last. Layer4 every10-20 trades A/B features/levels/3vs4confluences→quant expectancy,PF,win rate,MAE/MFE→business fees/payout→loopback NEXT session. Label20=70%at1:5RR is prior illustrative claim, not estimated parameters. Entire diagram is methodology, not additional price chart.
